content.short: Symbiosis is a cross-chain bridge and swap protocol for moving assets across many blockchain networks.
content.description: Symbiosis is a cross-chain liquidity and swap protocol that lets users exchange assets between different blockchains from one interface. The protocol routes trades across supported networks, making it possible to bridge and swap tokens without manually moving through separate bridge and DEX steps. Symbiosis also offers products for swaps, staking, zaps, pools, and DAO participation. For Mantle users, it acts as an access layer for moving liquidity into or out of the network while keeping cross-chain execution simpler and more direct.
content.meta: Symbiosis enables cross-chain swaps, bridges, staking, zaps, and liquidity tools. Discover Symbiosis on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
